title: Pipeline cannot read the documented input layout
current_behavior: Running pipeline with CSVs under data/raw/bicycle-thefts fails with cannot concat empty list.
expected_behavior: Read that directory, validate each input, and publish every input row only after a successful export.
root_cause: The default glob targeted data/raw/*.csv. The old per-load-file destination also copied each shard to one live path.
impact: The documented setup cannot rebuild its essential dataset. Direct copies also expose incomplete output; multiple load shards could overwrite one another.
reproduction: Put two valid yearly CSVs under a temporary raw/bicycle-thefts directory and invoke main with temporary raw/processed paths.
verification: test_pipeline.py: multi-file row count, actionable empty input, malformed input preserves old output, failed partial write preserves old output and removes staging. Full local input rebuilt to a temporary directory: 63,083 rows, no live data changed.

title: Malformed compact dates become Excel serial dates
current_behavior: 20241301 silently becomes year 57318 instead of failing validation.
expected_behavior: Reject invalid calendar dates; retain documented date formats and unknown/null values.
root_cause: The coalesce fallback interpreted any integer as an Excel day count.
impact: Corrupt dates can break Python/Pydantic date conversion and move incidents outside the visible period.
reproduction: Pass 20241301 or 20250230 to parse_types with an otherwise valid hour.
verification: test_parsing.py rejects malformed compact dates; valid slash dates, compact dates, five-digit Excel serials and unknowns still parse.

title: Hours outside 0–23 enter the dataset
expected_behavior: Reject values outside 0–23 while retaining 不明/null.
root_cause: Int8 conversion checked storage range rather than the domain of hours.
impact: Summary totals can disagree with the 24 hourly bins and hour filters.
reproduction: Pass each invalid hour to parse_types with a valid date.
verification: test_parsing.py tests negative, 24, 127, fractional and nonnumeric hours plus valid boundaries.

title: Duplicate area names select the smaller population
current_behavior: 壱岐団地 thefts map to 40135026002 (population 1,163), contrary to the documented preference for 40135026001 (3,537).
expected_behavior: Choose the most populous matching area deterministically.
root_cause: A descending population sort was followed by a dictionary comprehension; later, smaller areas overwrote earlier entries.
impact: Thefts appear in the wrong polygon and per-capita rates use the wrong denominator.
reproduction: Call area_lookup on the two same-name areas in either input order.
verification: test_area_matching.py checks both orders; population sort plus key-code tie break and first-entry preservation.

title: Parent-town and 大字 fallbacks do not compose
current_behavior: 北原１丁目 fails to match 大字北原 when both a parent-town and prefix fallback are needed.
expected_behavior: Apply the 大字 fallback to the normalized name and its parent town.
root_cause: Only the original name received the prefix.
reproduction: Use a lookup containing only (40135, 大字北原) and match 北原１丁目.
verification: test_area_matching.py covers composed fallbacks, ward isolation and null names.

title: A single legacy year can fail API startup
current_behavior: Reading or renaming optional columns fails when a whole year lacks them.
expected_behavior: Require identifying/date/hour columns; fill absent optional category columns with typed nulls.
root_cause: The loader requested every possible yearly column unconditionally.
impact: Valid supported yearly input cannot be served unless other years happen to supply all columns.
reproduction: Load a frame with date, hour, city, area and legacy 発生場所の属性 but without newer place/age/lock columns.
verification: test_area_matching.py checks successful join, legacy place fallback and null age.

title: Accepted date windows cause HTTP 500 overflow
current_behavior: Very large days, end=0001-01-01, or a representable current window with an unrepresentable prior window produce 500.
expected_behavior: Return a documented 422 validation response before constructing invalid dates.
root_cause: days had no calendar bound, and previous-window subtraction was unchecked.
impact: Untrusted query parameters trigger predictable service errors and failed statistics requests.
reproduction: Request by-area and summary with days=10**100; or end=0001-01-01 and days=1; or end=2025-01-01 and days=500000.
verification: test_api.py checks all cases on both endpoints and normal current/previous totals. 422 detail follows the existing validation-error shape.

title: Timeline contract loses empty months and accepts unknown areas
current_behavior: Unknown areas return 200 with an empty list while summary returns 404; filters remove zero-count months from the timeline.
expected_behavior: Unknown keys return 404; valid filtered timelines retain a common monthly calendar with explicit zeros.
root_cause: The timeline did not validate area membership or reindex grouped results against the calendar.
impact: Clients cannot distinguish invalid keys from valid areas without thefts, and sparse calendars are ambiguous.
reproduction: Request timeline?key_code=missing; then filter a fixture with January thefts and no matching February/March thefts.
verification: test_api.py checks consistent 404, January count and zero months from coverage start through the latest data month.

title: Async requests run before prerequisites and retain stale errors
current_behavior: Slow metadata starts no-period requests; an error from an old key remains visible during a new request. Summary, outline and timeline errors were omitted from App error selection.
expected_behavior: Wait for prerequisites, hide obsolete errors, abort stale requests, and surface required endpoint failures.
root_cause: The hook had no disabled key and always returned the last error, regardless of key; App checked only three request errors.
impact: Slow/recovering requests can show false failure screens; failed secondary data can leave stale or incomplete views without an explanation.
reproduction: Mount with no request key, then a rejecting key, then a pending key; resolve an older request after switching keys.
verification: async.test.tsx checks zero calls before prerequisites, error reset on key changes, abort signal and stale-response rejection. App error aggregation reviewed statically.

title: Ranking shows comparison deltas outside data coverage
current_behavior: Early/all-period windows show ▲ increases against an unsupported previous window, although summary correctly suppresses that comparison.
expected_behavior: Show — when the preceding full window is outside coverage.
root_cause: Ranking did not apply the coverage check used by summary.
impact: Users can read unavailable historical data as a real increase in thefts.
reproduction: Render ranking for end=2018-01-02, days=7, coverage starting 2018-01-01, count=5 and prev_count=0.
verification: display.test.tsx verifies — near the start and ▲5 when comparison is supported; baseline component was rerun with the corrected JSX harness and failed as expected.

title: Hour-chart buttons cannot be reached or activated by keyboard
current_behavior: Clickable divs declare role=button but have no tab stop, keyboard handler or accessible label.
expected_behavior: Tab reaches each interactive bar; Enter/Space selects its hour; accessible text identifies the value.
root_cause: Only mouse click behavior was implemented.
impact: Keyboard-only users cannot use the advertised hour filtering interaction.
reproduction: Render Bars with onClick; inspect tabIndex and dispatch Enter/Space.
verification: display.test.tsx asserts tabIndex=0, both key activations and a nonempty accessible label.

title: Low-population zero-count areas show a misleading numeric rate
current_behavior: Areas absent from both count windows show 0 in the rate popup even when population is below the suppression threshold.
expected_behavior: Show — below the population threshold, consistently with the map fill and summary.
root_cause: The formatter returned zero for missing count entries without checking population.
impact: The popup implies a valid rate where the API intentionally suppresses it.
reproduction: Format a rate with no count entry, population=50 and minimum=100.
verification: map-display.test.ts checks suppressed rates, valid zero rates and count mode.

title: Map focus ignores overlay space and changes persistent padding
current_behavior: fitBounds uses padding=60 on all sides, ignoring the measured panels, and stores that padding by default.
expected_behavior: Fit the selected feature within the visible area and leave persistent layout padding intact.
root_cause: The camera call overrode overlay-aware padding and did not set retainPadding=false.
impact: A selected area can be framed beneath controls, and subsequent pans can use displaced padding.
reproduction: Inspect focus options for top=250/right=372 insets and the actual fitBounds caller.
verification: map-display.test.ts checks overlay-adjusted padding and retainPadding=false. Source readiness and caller wiring reviewed; live GPU behavior remains unverified.

title: Download failures leave shared partial files and metadata can wait indefinitely
current_behavior: A failed extraction leaves fukuoka.pmtiles.part; retries reuse that path. The metadata request has no timeout.
expected_behavior: Use a unique staging directory, remove partial output on failure, retain the old basemap and bound metadata waiting.
root_cause: A fixed staging filename had no cleanup, and urlopen used its default unlimited timeout.
impact: Failed or concurrent downloads can interfere with retries, and an unresponsive listing can hang the command.
reproduction: Mock extraction to write a partial file then fail; mock urlopen and inspect its timeout.
verification: test_download.py checks cleanup, preservation of the previous map, successful replacement, parent-directory creation and a 30-second metadata timeout. No full planet extraction is run.

title: js-yaml merge-chain CPU exhaustion
expected_behavior: Use a release patched for every advisory, at least 4.3.0 for this issue.
root_cause: A transitive API-generator dependency resolved to a vulnerable release.
impact: Crafted YAML processed by development tooling can consume excessive CPU. This dependency is not in the shipped browser application; no production exploit is demonstrated.
reproduction: Run pnpm audit against the original committed package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml in a temporary directory.
verification: frontend-audit-before.json reports the high advisory; after override to ^4.3.2, lock resolves 4.3.2 and frontend-audit-after.json reports zero advisories. API generation and build pass.

title: Mobile layout hides the only metric selector
current_behavior: At widths <=760px the floating legend is hidden, taking the count/per-capita radio group with it.
expected_behavior: Keep metric selection available in the mobile time panel.
root_cause: The selector existed only inside the hidden legend.
impact: Mobile users cannot switch the map metric.
reproduction: Render the time panel and inspect the mobile breakpoint hiding the floating legend.
verification: mobile-controls.test.tsx mounts the panel, finds the mobile selector and switches to rate. CSS breakpoint/display rules reviewed statically; actual viewport layout remains a browser-test limitation.
